about.description: Phoenix VII is a 15-story, steel-and-concrete beachfront tower featuring 247 Gulf-front condos in Orange Beach, Alabama. All units face the water and provide uninterrupted Gulf views. The property offers spacious 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals, many with custom updates including granite countertops and enhanced finishes. Each condo includes a private Gulf-front balcony, fully equipped kitchen, in-unit washer and dryer, large closets, and modern connectivity. Popular with families, snowbirds, destination wedding groups, and long-term owners.
about.elevator_pitch: Phoenix VII is a 15-story beachfront condo tower in Orange Beach offering 247 Gulf-front units with direct beach access and year-round amenities for families and vacation renters.
